name: showhide-pass
blurb: Password input with show/hide toggle icon.
description: A simple password input field with an Eye/EyeOff icon that toggles between password and text display modes.
use_when: Adding basic password visibility toggle to simple login or password entry forms.
avoid_when: When additional validation, strength indicators, or confirmation fields are needed.
a11y: Toggle icon is clickable but lacks aria-label or aria-pressed. Input is semantic.
